summary: This directory provides unit testing for the auto-form generation engine. It specifically covers the validation logic and the process of building default values for forms, ensuring the core engine produces accurate data structures and adheres to form field requirements.
responsibilities: Test generation of default form values
Ensure consistency in form field processing
relationships: Validation tests ensure that the form engine correctly enforces field constraints.
Default value tests verify the engine correctly initializes form data structures based on schema definitions.
designDecisions: Isolation of engine logic for unit testing
